lint._scope: eslint src vitest.config.ts, ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG=true, flat config eslint.config.mjs

emptyCatch._definition: A catch clause whose brace-balanced body, after stripping comments, is either empty (strict) or contains nothing but console.* statements (consoleOnly). Bodies with real statements are ignored. Scoped to src/ excluding test files, matching what lint.mjs lints. Report-only, not enforced: an empty catch is not always a defect, since best-effort telemetry genuinely does not warrant failing a build.
emptyCatch._measured: 177 strict + 36 console-only at fb84dae, before v26 section 1. Section 1 reclassified the catches on the write paths rather than deleting them, so most moved from `strict` to `console-only`: the total fell, the shape changed.

fileSizeBudgets._why: Fails on exceedance only. These are physical line counts, which run ~8% higher than PowerShell's Measure-Object -Line because that cmdlet skips blank lines. Covers every file at or above 800 lines. Raising a budget is a deliberate act: the diff is the record that the god files are growing.
